title.narrative: EU4Business Initiative - Phase III

description.narrative: EU4Business Facility contributes to the implementation of the Economic and Investment Plan and, doing so, contribute to sustainable and equitable economic growth in the region. The programme will 1) ensure the regular and thorough monitoring of all EU projects in support of private sector development in the Eastern Neighbourhood and related country Flagships; 2) assess the impact and results of EU4Business regional and bilateral projects; 3) maximise the outreach and the visibility of EU support
